Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Law Graduate from a recognized university with enrollment as an advocate. Minimum 5 years of professional experience. Knowledge of Maharashtra Zilla Parishad and Panchayat Acts and related service rules. Proficiency in Marathi, Hindi, and English.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Zilla Parishad Dhule Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.zpdhule.maharashtra.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Zilla Parishad Dhule Legal Officer (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Legal Officer (Contractual) position at Zilla Parishad Dhule is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Law Graduates from a recognized university and enrolled as an advocate. Additionally, a minimum of 5 years of professional experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Legal Officer (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Legal Officer (Contractual) position is 50 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Legal Officer (Contractual) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Legal Officer (Contractual) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will the candidates be selected for the Legal Officer (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Legal Officer (Contractual) role involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to clear both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Zilla Parishad Dhule Legal Officer (Contractual) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q9. Does Zilla Parishad Dhule offer any age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Zilla Parishad Dhule, which is https://www.zpdhule.maharashtra.gov.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section.
